GAME NIGHT COMPASS — DECIDED BOARD

The four keeper layouts, all wearing the decided system:
· QUALITY (per player count) = filled gradient badges and letters, continuous red-to-green, provisionally Variant 1 (deepest-green S).
· TEACH TIME = backdrop wash on each row/card, a hint of green when simple warming to red when heavy. No letter badges for difficulty anymore.

Top row: Design A (paper) as list and cards. Bottom row: Design C (dark) as list and cards. Mobile comp right; badge-gradient decision board below.

STILL OPEN: the S badge color.
Variant 1 (continuous ramp, deepest-green S) is what all four boards wear now. Variant 2 breaks S out — ink, teal, or brass. When you want to see a swap, say so and I restamp the boards in place — no separate canvases per variant.
